title: Higher Ext vanishes for coherent sheaves on a regular curve
statement: Let $X$ be a regular Noetherian scheme of finite dimension $d$ and let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. Then $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=0$ for every $i>d$. In particular, for $X=\mathbf P^1_k$ with $k$ a field one has $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=0$ for all $i\ge2$.
